module.name: Kubernetes Network Setup (Multus NADs)
module.description: Creates Multus Network Attachment Definitions (NADs) for external and internal networks. Required for BNK legacy SPK controller mode with multiple network interfaces.

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster (used for resource identification)

required.name: external_subnet_cidrs
required.description: CIDR blocks for external network subnets

required.name: internal_subnet_cidrs
required.description: CIDR blocks for internal network subnets

optional.name: external_nad_name
optional.description: Name for external network attachment definition

optional.name: internal_nad_name
optional.description: Name for internal network attachment definition

optional.name: cni_plugin
optional.description: CNI plugin to use (macvlan, ipvlan, bridge)

optional.name: enable_ipam
optional.description: Enable IPAM (IP Address Management) for NADs

key_outputs.name: external_nad_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the external network attachment definition

key_outputs.name: internal_nad_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the internal network attachment definition

key_outputs.name: nads_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating NADs are created and ready
